description: Read one template: its size, description and every editable text and number, as field keys with their current values (e.g. "w0.text": "Annual Report 2026", "w5.datasets.0.values": [820, 1050]). The same keys change the template when it is rendered. With preview set to true, the template's preview image is included.

preview.description: Also return the template preview image (default false).

name: get_template

fields.description: Every editable text and number, with the key that changes it.

value.description: Current value: text, a number, or a list.

widget.description: The widget type the field belongs to.

title: Get template fields
